scope: Direct whole combined candidate versus already optimized stable baseline; not stock upstream or isolated reduce12 attribution
method: Fresh-process A1/B1/B2/A2, INT8 KV, greedy temperature=0/top_p=1/top_k=1/seed=12345, no prompt reuse

decision.method: direct fresh-process ABBA; no sum of isolated gains

limits: One fresh-process ABBA with 65536 prompt tokens and 1024 outputs per arm; not a broad workload or confidence-interval study.
The baseline is already optimized stable ce, not stock upstream.
PP/TG are native rates; loading and request wall time are separate.
Gains are directly measured release-versus-release; do not add isolated optimization percentages.

Thermal samples are discrete, not continuous telemetry. Critical-temperature sysfs values were checked at runtime but not retained in samples, so exact critical-minus-10C margins cannot be recalculated from this receipt alone.
publication_scope: Numeric derivative only: private infrastructure paths, filesystem provenance, manifests, configuration hashes and service-operation details are omitted.
